definitions.short: Cush (or Ethiopia), the name of a son of Ham, and of his territory; also of an Israelite
definitions.full: H3568. Kuwsh I. כּוּשׁ proper name, masculine person, of a people and territory (Egyptian Kœš, Steind BAS i, 593 , Assyrian Kûsu, Id ib. Dl Pa 251 ; Kaši in Tel Amarna tablets, see Wkl Tel Am. 39* ); — 1 1st 'son' of חָם Gen 10:6-7 , (P) = 1Chr 1:8-9 , ᵐ5 Ξους , ᵑ9 Chus , from whom descended according to these verses the southernmost peoples known to Hebrews. 2 land and people of southern Nile-valley , or Upper Egypt, extending from Syene ( Ezek 29:10 ) indefinitely to the south, ᵐ5 Αιθιοπια , Αιθιοπες : a. the land Isa 11:11 ; 18:1 ; Zeph 3:10 ; Ezek 29:10 ; Job 28:19 ; Est 1:1 ; 8:9 . b. the people Isa 20:4 ; Jer 46:9 ; Ezek 38:5 ; personified Psa 68:32 . c. indeterminate, either land or people , or including both: Isa 20:3 , 5 ; 43:3 ; 45:14 ; 2Kin 19:9 = Isa 37:9 ; Nahum 3:9 ; Ezek 30:4-5 , 9 ; Psa 87:4 ( ᵐ5 λαὸς Αιθιοπων ). 3 in Gen 10:8 (J) = 1Chr 1:10 כּוּשׁ is error for כַּשׁ = Babylonian Kaššu, according to Schr COT on Gen 10:6 , Dl Pa 51 ff. 72 f. and most Assyriologists; so perhaps also 2:13 (J), yet see Hpt Über Ld. u. Meer, 1894-5, No. 15 . II. כּוּשׁ proper name, masculine a Benjamite , Psa 7:1 (title), ᵐ5 Χουσει υιὁῦ Ιεμενει .
